records.title: A Tabular Schedule Abstraction for Communication-Aware Evaluation of Pipeline-Parallel LLM Training
records.reason: This work provides analytical/tabular/simulation abstractions for evaluating pipeline-parallel LLM training schedules. It studies training execution and reports no inference or serving optimization; its stated peak-memory goal was not achieved.

records.title: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
records.reason: Chain-of-Models studies cross-model auditing of LLM judges to reduce bias in evaluations. It is about judge reliability and model-auditing structure, not improving LLM inference resource use or serving efficiency.
